name: Persona ~Ingyaku no Kamen~
source:
A series of gruesome murders shocks Japan. Young women are kidnapped, tortured, and killed under mysterious circumstances...

The protagonist wakes up in what looks like a hospital, but is in fact a special psychiatric facility on a space station. The hero doesn't remember anything, not even his name. Three young women - Shelly, Elisa, and Aoba - will help him to find his memory, and he will gradually realize who he is and what is his mission.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/persona-ingyaku-no-kamen]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
一连串骇人听闻的凶杀案震惊了日本。年轻女性接连遭到绑架、折磨，并在扑朔迷离的情况下被杀害……

主人公在一个看似医院的地方醒来，那里其实是设于空间站内的特殊精神医疗机构。他什么都不记得，甚至想不起自己的名字。雪莉、艾丽莎和青叶三名年轻女性会帮助他找回记忆，他也将逐渐明白自己究竟是谁，又肩负着怎样的使命。

[引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/persona-ingyaku-no-kamen]Moby Games[/url]]
